sm_top.sm: British counterterrorism police made explosives arrests near RAF Fairford, an air base used for American strikes on Iran.
The Saudi-led coalition intercepted three Houthi ballistic missiles heading towards Riyadh and Khamis Mushait.
Houthis reported 106 Saudi airstrikes as the Yemeni government launched a counter-offensive.
UAE officials stated a Flydubai co-pilot planned a suicide attack targeting Israel.
The coalition reported that three ballistic missiles launched by the Houthi militia toward Riyadh and Khamis Mushait were intercepted and destroyed.
Houthi missile/drone attack on King Khalid International Airport killed three Saudi citizens and caused dozens of injuries.
Ukraine's Air Force reported that Russian strikes killed at least 10 people and injured 45 across Ukraine, following an overnight attack using 142 Shahed-type drones.
Airstrikes and explosions were reported in the Yemeni capital of Sanaa.
A drone strike on the Sheraro IDP camp in Tigray killed eight people.
The U.S. is deploying a third aircraft carrier strike group to the Middle East amid rising tensions with Iran.
Russia launched over 200 missiles at Ukraine, including North Korean KN-23 ballistic missiles.
Houthi forces launched missile and drone attacks targeting Aden airport.
Saudi Ministry of Defense reports the interception of 5 ballistic missiles, 7 drones, and 1 cruise missile.
Ukrainian strikes hit the Redkino cruise-missile fuel plant in Tver Oblast, a Yandex data center in Kaluga, and a Belgorod oil depot.
President Zelensky reports that Russia launched 1,900 drones and 25 missiles over the past week.
Fighting reported between Ethiopia and Eritrea raises fears of regional escalation as Ethiopian forces act in self-defense.
Hamas stated that Al-Amoudi, a possible successor to Sinwar, survived an Israeli strike in Gaza.
The aircraft carrier USS Abraham Lincoln returned to San Diego following a combat deployment.
A paramilitary drone strike killed at least 40 people at a displaced persons site near the Ethiopian border.
Houthi-aligned media claim a cruise missile targeted a ship near the coast of Qatar, causing a fire.
Russian strikes hit a key bridge and war supplies in Kharkiv.
Iranian media reported that a 2.5 million-barrel oil tanker was struck in the Strait of Hormuz.
Ukrainian Air Force reports air defenses intercepted 117 out of 160 Russian attack drones launched overnight, with impacts recorded at 14 locations.
Mali announced the recapture of Kidal without a fight.
The Saudi-led coalition claims to have destroyed 136 Houthi military targets in a large-scale operation.
The IRGC claimed a strike on the Vietnamese LPG tanker NV Sunshine.
Iran states it targeted a gas tanker in the Strait of Hormuz.
Russian guided aerial bomb strikes targeted Zaporizhzhia Oblast, resulting in casualties and damage.
Iran announces plans to soon close unauthorized shipping routes in the Strait of Hormuz.
The Ukrainian Air Force reported guided aerial bomb strikes targeting Kharkiv and Sumy oblasts.
The Saudi-led coalition reported shooting down a Houthi missile.
Reports note that Israeli military actions in Gaza continue despite announcements of a ceasefire.
At least 71 people were killed in intercommunal clashes in Rumbek, South Sudan.
Russian MoD claimed air defense forces intercepted and destroyed 560 Ukrainian drones overnight across multiple regions and seas.
Ukraine launches nearly 900 drones at Russia as Kyiv braces for an expected massive aerial assault.
The Yemeni Army launched the 'Dawn of Yemen' operation against Houthi forces.
A renewed Houthi missile/drone strike on King Khalid International Airport led to evacuations and the airport’s suspension.
NATO proceeded with its Steadfast Noon nuclear deterrence exercise despite warnings from Russia.
Military personnel monitor a drone-hit drifting ship that entered Bulgarian waters.
A Russian glide bomb attack on Zaporizhzhia killed multiple people and injured several others.
